offers_products.reason: Manufactures commercial and residential washers and dryers under Speed Queen, UniMac, Huebsch and other brands.

offers_services.reason: Services such as parts, support and financing are incidental to equipment sales; the main offering is manufactured machines.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Speed Queen residential washers and dryers are sold to households through retailers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells commercial laundry equipment through distributors to laundromats, hotels, hospitals, and other commercial operators.

recurring_revenue.reason: Washers and dryers are durable equipment bought every several years; parts and service are a smaller share.

cyclical_demand.reason: Customers can defer laundry equipment replacement or expansion in downturns, such as laundromat owners, hotels and homeowners.

big_ticket.reason: Commercial washers and dryers and home appliances are infrequent, high-cost purchases relative to buyer spending.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured laundry machines, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are distributors, laundromat owners, small commercial operators and households, not mainly large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Heavy manufacturing with factories in Ripon, Manitowoc and Chon Buri requires ongoing plant investment.

notes: Commercial laundry is the larger part; the residential Speed Queen line is the other part.
